ee:object-store-caching-strategy.name: matrixCachingStrategy
ee:object-store-caching-strategy.doc:name: Matrix Caching Strategy
ee:object-store-caching-strategy.keyGenerationExpression: #[if ((p('matrix.source') default 'classpath') startsWith 'exchange') ('compatibility-matrix-' ++ (floor((now() as Number {unit: 'seconds'}) / (p('matrix.refreshSeconds') as Number)) as String)) else 'compatibility-matrix-static']

sub-flow.name: pf-load-matrix
sub-flow.doc:description: Load and cache the compatibility matrix (Exchange with classpath fallback) into vars.matrix

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO START pf-load-matrix enter
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'START - pf-load-matrix - loading compatibility matrix | source=' ++ (p('matrix.source') default 'classpath')]

try.doc:name: TRY fetch matrix from Exchange (fallback to classpath)

flow-ref.doc:name: Flow Ref sf-exchange-http-get | Get Exchange Version
flow-ref.name: sf-exchange-http-get

ee:transform.doc:name: DW extract release/latest version
ee:transform.doc:description: Parse maven-metadata.xml and pick versioning.release (else latest)

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain var meta = read(payload, "application/xml") --- (meta.metadata.versioning.release default meta.metadata.versioning.latest) as String

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO resolved matrix version
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'matrix.source NOT EQUALS exchange-latest | resolved matrix version=' ++ p('matrix.exchange.version')]

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Version from config
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Getting version for matrix from configuration file | source=' ++ (p('matrix.source') default 'classpath')]

set-variable.value: #['/api/v3/maven/' ++ p('matrix.exchange.orgId') ++ '/' ++ p('matrix.exchange.assetId') ++ '/' ++ vars.matrixVersion ++ '/' ++ p('matrix.exchange.assetId') ++ '-' ++ vars.matrixVersion ++ (if ((p('matrix.exchange.classifier') default '') != '') ('-' ++ p('matrix.exchange.classifier')) else '') ++ '.' ++ p('matrix.exchange.packaging')]
set-variable.doc:name: Set urlPath

flow-ref.doc:name: Flow Ref sf-exchange-http-get | Get Exchange matrix asset
flow-ref.name: sf-exchange-http-get

ee:transform.doc:name: DW parse Exchange YAML
ee:transform.doc:description: Parse the fetched Exchange asset body as YAML

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR Exchange fetch failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Exchange matrix fetch failed (' ++ (error.description default 'unknown error') ++ ') - falling back to bundled classpath matrix']

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Version from config
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Config to get matrix from Exchange is FALSE, falling back to bundled classpath matrix']

ee:transform.doc:name: DW readUrl compatibility-matrix.yaml
ee:transform.doc:description: Read and parse compatibility-matrix.yaml from the classpath using DataWeave readUrl

set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vars.matrix
set-variable.doc:description: Store parsed matrix object in vars.matrix for downstream use

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END pf-load-matrix done
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'matrix loaded | schemaVersion=' ++ (vars.matrix.schemaVersion default 'unknown') ++ ' | targetRuntime=' ++ (vars.matrix.target.runtime default 'unknown')]

sub-flow.name: pf-resolve-coordinates
sub-flow.doc:description: Resolve repo coordinates for vars.appName (registry → override → convention). Sets vars.coords.

ee:cache.doc:name: CACHE Read App Registry YAML
ee:cache.doc:description: Cache the app-registry.yaml read; constant key means one I/O per JVM lifetime

ee:transform.doc:name: DW readUrl app-registry.yaml
ee:transform.doc:description: Read and parse app-registry.yaml from the classpath using DataWeave readUrl

set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vars.registry
set-variable.doc:description: Store parsed registry object in vars.registry for precedence resolution

when.doc:name: enforceAllowList=true AND app not in registry

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR App Not Allow-Listed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'app=' ++ vars.appName ++ ' not in registry and enforceAllowList=true — rejecting']

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'App "' ++ vars.appName ++ '" is not in the allow-list registry. Add an entry to app-registry.yaml or set registry.enforceAllowList=false.']
raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION:APP_NOT_REGISTERED (allow-list)

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Allow-List Check Passed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'allow-list check passed for app=' ++ vars.appName ++ ' | enforceAllowList=' ++ p('registry.enforceAllowList')]

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Resolve Coordinates (3-tier precedence)
ee:transform.doc:description: Resolve owner, repo, appPath, orgId, defaultBranch via registry → request override → convention

choice.doc:name: CHOICE owner and repo resolved?
choice.doc:description: Validate owner and repo are non-null after all three precedence tiers

when.doc:name: owner or repo is null after resolution

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR Incomplete Coordinates
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'app=' ++ vars.appName ++ ' | owner=' ++ (vars.coords.owner default 'null') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.coords.repo default 'null') ++ ' — cannot locate repo without owner and repo coordinates']

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Cannot resolve repo coordinates for app "' ++ vars.appName ++ '". Please provide owner and repo by adding an entry to app-registry.yaml or including owner/repo in the request body.']
raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION:APP_NOT_REGISTERED (missing owner or repo)

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO Coordinates Resolved
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'app=' ++ vars.appName ++ ' | owner=' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '') ++ ' | appPath=' ++ (vars.coords.appPath default '') ++ ' | orgId=' ++ (vars.coords.orgId default '') ++ ' | defaultBranch=' ++ (vars.coords.defaultBranch default '')]

choice.doc:name: CHOICE branch already known?
choice.doc:description: Only call GitHub when no user/registry branch was resolved

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Send Request
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'Sending Request to URL: '/repos/' ' ++ vars.coords.owner ++ '/' ++ vars.coords.repo]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- (vars.coords - 'defaultBranch') ++ { defaultBranch: (if (isEmpty(payload as String)) p('github.defaultBranch') else (payload as String)) }]
set-variable.doc:name: PV SET coords.defaultBranch (discovered)

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END default_branch discovered
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'discovered default_branch=' ++ (vars.coords.defaultBranch default '?') ++ ' for ' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '') ++ '/' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '')]

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN default_branch discovery failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'default_branch discovery failed (' ++ (error.description default 'unknown') ++ ') — using config default ' ++ (p('github.defaultBranch') default '')]
